title: Spotlite plugin response
description: What a plugin's executable prints: one JSON object. Every key is optional and printing nothing is fine. A streamed action prints lines matching #/$defs/streamLine instead. See plugins/README.md.

items.description: Rows for list and search, and for a keepOpen run. Rows past 500 are ignored; a malformed row is skipped on its own.

copy.description: Text to put on the clipboard.

open.description: A URL or file path to open.

update.description: Changes how the plugin's commands look in root results.

toast.description: A message shown after the run: a string, or an object.

style.description: failure shows even when confirmation messages are off.

commandUpdate.description: Changes how one command looks until expires or the next update. Naming only the command restores the manifest's look.

command.description: A command id from the manifest.

subtitle.description: {expires} shows the deadline in the user's time format.

pid.description: A process of the same user. The look ends when it exits.

menuBar.description: Also shows the look as a menu-bar item while it lasts: the icon, the subtitle as tooltip and first line of its menu, then these actions.

actions.description: Only open, copy, run and list actions; others are dropped, then at most 8 are kept. A list opens the panel at that level.

streamLine.title: Stream line
streamLine.description: One line of a streamed (NDJSON) response. An object with a title is a row; any other object is a response line, whose items are more rows and whose toast, copy, open and update apply when the program exits successfully.
